Crüger's famous tune; four-voice setting, melody in top voice; incipit read from dense chords - check by eye. Variants: 1) F# in Dresden 1694 and many later; 2) Prax. 1666-1690 (sharp, 'very striking'); 3) Weissenfels 1714; 4) Klein 1785. Original rhythm kept until Kittel 1790 and Weimar 1803.
